name: Hiochimura Gangu Tanetsuke Rankou no Shou
original_name: 緋落村玩具 種付け乱交の章
source:
In the legendary "village of fugitives", 
young rich girls are abducted by a twisted gang for an orgy unlike any other. 
You met one of the girls, and she begged for help, 
but in trying to free the girls your fate was sealed... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092507.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在传说中的“逃亡者村”，富裕的年轻女孩被扭曲的帮派绑架，参加前所未有的群交。
你遇见了其中一名女孩，她恳求你帮助她，
但在试图解救女孩们时，你的命运也已注定……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092507.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
